items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: During that night when we had that band contest... Black Happy on drum

ctx.x: And the night we went on the Pelican to play it against the Pelican, the Silvertone Orchestra, with, that's when originally that split up from the original Tuxedo band. stuff

That's when he made up the band on the Pelican. Well I can give you some of the names of the men's. During that night when we had that band contest, well that didn't have, Black Happy on drum, and Bay Bay originally we had a boy by the name of Bat Brown on trumpet and Shot Madison. He got his picture in the other right. They was on the trumpet and some of the sax section. We had Joe Watkins on clarinet in sax. They used to play with the Si Morgan band too, Joe Watkins. Not Joe Watkins, the drummer.
